subject: general
question: The simple interest on ₹1,280 at 5% p.a. in 3 years is:
solution:
**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹1,280

Rate of interest (R) = 5% p.a.

Time (T) = 3 years

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (P × R × T) / 100

**Calculation:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (₹1,280 × 5 × 3) / 100

⇒ SI = ₹19,200 / 100

⇒ SI = ₹192

**The simple interest on ₹1,280 at 5% p.a. in 3 years is ₹192.**
